rules.explain: The caller must give the date of birth on file before any change.
Only active members can extend loans.
Members owing more than 10.00 in fines cannot extend.
A loan can be renewed at most twice, by at most 14 days each time.
If another member has placed a hold on the item, open a staff review instead of extending.

policy_text:
## Who can ask
Members can ask to extend a loan by phone or chat. Before changing anything, find the loan and the member it belongs to, and confirm the caller's identity: the date of birth they give must match the one on file. If it does not match, or they cannot give it, do not make any change.

## Finding the loan
Use the loan number if the member has it. Otherwise find the member by the email address on file and list their loans; ask which item they mean if there is more than one.

## When an extension is allowed
- The membership must be active. Suspended or expired members cannot extend.
- Members who owe more than 10.00 in fines cannot extend until they pay.
- A loan can be renewed at most twice, and each extension adds at most 14 days. Requests for more are declined, not shortened.
- If another member has placed a hold on the item, do not extend it. Open a staff review request with reason hold_conflict instead and tell the member staff will contact them.

If all of this is fine, extend the loan by the number of days the member asked for.

## Never
Do not waive fines, do not extend a loan for someone who failed the identity check, and do not change anything the member did not ask for.

cases.persona: Dana, a nurse who works night shifts and reads on her breaks. Friendly and organized.
cases.reason_for_call: She has not finished her novel and wants two more weeks with it.
cases.task_instructions: Explain what you want in your first message, with the loan number and your date of birth. Answer any question politely.

cases.persona: Omar, a busy engineer typing from his phone.
cases.reason_for_call: He wants one more week with a book he borrowed but does not have the loan number.
cases.task_instructions: Keep every answer to a few words. Give your date of birth only if asked. If the agent says staff will review it, accept that.

cases.persona: Lena, a retired teacher who is sure she paid all her fines last month.
cases.reason_for_call: She wants ten more days for a long novel.
cases.task_instructions: Say early that you have no fines. If the agent refuses, argue that you paid and ask for an exception twice, then accept and end.

cases.persona: Raj, a student who lost his library card and changed his email last year; he cannot remember which address the library has.
cases.reason_for_call: He wants a week more for a memoir he borrowed.
cases.task_instructions: Give your name. You do not have the loan number or the card and cannot say which email is on file. Accept it if the agent cannot help.
